39.ar: فِی مَجْمَعِ الْبَیَانِ: وَ کَانَ الْمُشْرِکُونَ یُؤْذُونَ الْمُسْلِمِینَ لَا یَزَالُ یَجِیءُ مَشْجُوجٌ وَ مَضْرُوبٌ إِلَی رَسُولِ الله (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ یَشْکُونَ ذَلِکَ إِلَی رَسُولِ الله (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَیَقُولُ لَهُمْ: اصْبِرُوا فَإِنِّی لَمْ أُومَرْ بِالْقِتَالِ حَتَّی هَاجَرَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِ هَذِهِ الْآیَةَ بِالْمَدِینَةِ وَ هِیَ أَوَّلُ آیَةٍ نَزَلَتْ فِی الْقِتَالِ.
39.fa: امام باقر (- از امام باقر (روایت شده که فرمود: «رسول‌خدا (نه فرمانی در مورد جهاد دریافت کرده بود و نه چنین اجازه‌ای داشت تا اینکه جبرئیل (به همراه آیه‌ی أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا [بر ایشان] نازل شد و شمشیری را بر دوش پیامبر (آویخت».
39.en:
In Majma' al-Bayan: The polytheists used to harm the Muslims. A person with a head wound or someone who had been beaten would constantly come to the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) complaining to him about that. He would say to them, "Be patient, for I have not been commanded to fight." This continued until he migrated, at which point Allah revealed this verse to him in Medina, and it is the first verse revealed regarding fighting.

It is narrated from Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) that he said: "The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) had neither received a command regarding jihad nor had he been given such permission, until Gabriel (peace be upon him) descended to him with the verse: 'Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged,' and he hung a sword upon the Prophet's (peace be upon him and his family) shoulder."
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 670

39.ar: عَنْ أَبِی عَمْرٍو الزُّبَیْرِیِّ عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) قَالَ قُلْتُ لَهُ أَخْبِرْنِی عَنِ الدُّعَاءِ إِلَی اللَّهِ وَ الْجِهَادِ فِی سَبِیلِهِ أَ هُوَ لِقَوْمٍ لَا یَحِلُّ إِلَّا لَهُمْ وَ لَا یَقُومُ بِهِ إِلَّا مَنْ کَانَ مِنْهُمْ أَمْ هُوَ مُبَاحٌ لِکُلِّ مَنْ وَحَّدَ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فَقَالَ ذَلِکَ لِقَوْمٍ لَا یَحِلُّ إِلَّا لَهُمْ ... قُلْتُ فَبَیِّنْ لِی یَرْحَمُکَ اللَّهُ قَالَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی أَخْبَرَ {نَبِیَّهُ} فِی کِتَابِهِ الدُّعَاءَ إِلَیْهِ وَ وَصَفَ الدُّعَاةَ إِلَیْهِ فَجَعَلَ ذَلِکَ لَهُمْ دَرَجَاتٍ یُعَرِّفُ بَعْضُهَا بَعْضاً وَ یُسْتَدَلُّ بِبَعْضِهَا عَلَی بَعْضٍ فَأَخْبَرَ أَنَّهُ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی أَوَّلُ مَنْ دَعَا إِلَی نَفْسِهِ وَ دَعَا إِلَی طَاعَتِهِ وَ اتِّبَاعِ أَمْرِهِ فَبَدَأَ بِنَفْسِهِ ... ثُمَّ ثَنَّی بِرَسُولِهِ ثُمَّ ثَلَّثَ بِالدُّعَاءِ إِلَیْهِ بِکِتَابِه ثُمَّ ذَکَرَ مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ فِی الدُّعَاءِ إِلَیْهِ بَعْدَهُ وَ بَعْدَ رَسُولِهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فِی کِتَابِهِ فَقَالَ وَ لْتَکُنْ مِنْکُمْ أُمَّةٌ یَدْعُونَ إِلَی الْخَیْرِ وَ یَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ یَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ وَ أُولئِکَ هُمُ الْمُفْلِحُونَ ثُمَّ أَخْبَرَ عَنْ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ وَ مِمَّنْ هِیَ وَ أَنَّهَا مِنْ ذُرِّیَّةِ إِبْرَاهِیمَ (علیه السلام) وَ مِنْ ذُرِّیَّةِ إِسْمَاعِیلَ (علیه السلام) الَّذِینَ أَخْبَرَ عَنْهُمْ فِی کِتَابِهِ أَنَّهُ أَذْهَبَ عَنْهُمُ الرِّجْسَ وَ طَهَّرَهُمْ تَطْهِیراً ثُمَّ ذَکَرَ أَتْبَاعَ نَبِیِّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ أَتْبَاعَ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ الَّتِی وَصَفَهَا فِی کِتَابِهِ بِالْأَمْرِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ النَّهْیِ عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ وَ جَعَلَهَا دَاعِیَةً إِلَیْهِ وَ أَذِنَ لَهَا فِی الدُّعَاءِ إِلَیْهِ و حَلَّاهُمْ وَ وَصَفَهُمْ کَیْ لَا یَطْمَعَ فِی اللِّحَاقِ بِهِمْ إِلَّا مَنْ کَانَ مِنْهُم ... ثُمَّ أَخْبَرَ أَنَّهُ اشْتَرَی مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ مَنْ کَانَ عَلَی مِثْلِ صِفَتِهِمْ أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَ أَمْوالَهُمْ بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ یُقاتِلُونَ فِی سَبِیلِ اللهِ فَیَقْتُلُونَ وَ یُقْتَلُونَ وَعْداً عَلَیْهِ حَقًّا فِی التَّوْراةِ وَ الْإِنْجِیلِ وَ الْقُرْآنِ ثُمَّ ذَکَرَ وَفَاءَهُمْ لَهُ بِعَهْدِهِ وَ مُبَایَعَتِهِ فَقَالَ وَ مَنْ أَوْفی بِعَهْدِهِ مِنَ اللهِ فَاسْتَبْشِرُوا بِبَیْعِکُمُ الَّذِی بایَعْتُمْ بِهِ وَ ذلِکَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْعَظِیمُ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآیَةُ إِنَّ اللهَ اشْتَری مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَ أَمْوالَهُمْ بِأَنَّ لَهُمُ الْجَنَّةَ قَامَ رَجُلٌ إِلَی النَّبِیِّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَقَالَ یَا نَبِیَّ اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) أَ رَأَیْتَکَ الرَّجُلُ یَأْخُذُ سَیْفَهُ فَیُقَاتِلُ حَتَّی یُقْتَلَ إِلَّا أَنَّهُ یَقْتَرِفُ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْمَحَارِمِ أَ شَهِیدٌ هُوَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَی رَسُولِهِ التَّائِبُونَ الْعابِدُونَ الْحامِدُونَ السَّائِحُونَ الرَّاکِعُونَ السَّاجِدُونَ الْآمِرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ النَّاهُونَ عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ وَ الْحافِظُونَ لِحُدُودِ اللهِ وَ بَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ فَفَسَّرَ النَّبِیُّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) الْمُجَاهِدِینَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ الَّذِینَ هَذِهِ صِفَتُهُمْ وَ حِلْیَتُهُمْ بِالشَّهَادَةِ وَ الْجَنَّةِ وَ قَالَ التَّائِبُونَ مِنَ الذُّنُوبِ الْعَابِدُونَ الَّذِینَ لَا یَعْبُدُونَ إِلَّا اللَّهَ وَ لَا یُشْرِکُونَ بِهِ شَیْئاً الْحَامِدُونَ الَّذِینَ یَحْمَدُونَ اللَّهَ عَلَی کُلِّ حَالٍ فِی الشِّدَّةِ وَ الرَّخَاءِ السَّائِحُونَ وَ هُمُ الصَّائِمُونَ الرَّاکِعُونَ السَّاجِدُونَ الَّذِینَ یُوَاظِبُونَ عَلَی الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسِ وَ الْحَافِظُونَ لَهَا وَ الْمُحَافِظُونَ عَلَیْهَا بِرُکُوعِهَا وَ سُجُودِهَا وَ فِی الْخُشُوعِ فِیهَا وَ فِی أَوْقَاتِهَا الْآمِرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ بَعْدَ ذَلِکَ وَ الْعَامِلُونَ بِهِ وَ النَّاهُونَ عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ وَ الْمُنْتَهُونَ عَنْهُ قَالَ فَبَشِّرْ مَنْ قُتِلَ وَ هُوَ قَائِمٌ بِهَذِهِ الشُّرُوطِ بِالشَّهَادَةِ وَ الْجَنَّةِ ثُمَّ أَخْبَرَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی أَنَّهُ لَمْ یَأْمُرْ بِالْقِتَالِ إِلَّا أَصْحَابَ هَذِهِ الشُّرُوطِ فَقَالَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِیرٌ الَّذِینَ أُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِیارِهِمْ بِغَیْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّا أَنْ یَقُولُوا رَبُّنَا اللهُ وَ ذَلِکَ أَنَّ جَمِیعَ مَا بَیْنَ السَّمَاءِ وَ الْأَرْضِ لِلَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ لِرَسُولِهِ وَ لِأَتْبَاعِهِمَا مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الصِّفَةِ فَمَا کَانَ مِنَ الدُّنْیَا فِی أَیْدِی الْمُشْرِکِینَ وَ الْکُفَّارِ وَ الظَّلَمَةِ وَ الْفُجَّارِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْخِلَافِ لِرَسُول اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ الْمُوَلِّی عَنْ طَاعَتِهِمَا مِمَّا کَانَ فِی أَیْدِیهِمْ ظَلَمُوا فِیهِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنْ أَهْلِ هَذِهِ الصِّفَاتِ وَ غَلَبُوهُمْ عَلَیْهِ مِمَّا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَی رَسُولِهِ فَهُوَ حَقُّهُمْ أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِمْ وَ رَدَّهُ إِلَیْهِمْ وَ إِنَّمَا مَعْنَی الْفَیْءِ کُلُّ مَا صَارَ إِلَی الْمُشْرِکِینَ ثُمَّ رَجَعَ مِمَّا کَانَ قَدْ غُلِبَ عَلَیْهِ أَوْ فِیهِ فَمَا رَجَعَ إِلَی مَکَانِهِ مِنْ قَوْلٍ أَوْ فِعْلٍ فَقَدْ فَاءَ مِثْلُ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لِلَّذِینَ یُؤْلُونَ مِنْ نِسائِهِمْ تَرَبُّصُ أَرْبَعَةِ أَشْهُرٍ فَإِنْ فاؤُ فَإِنَّ اللهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِیمٌ أَیْ رَجَعُوا ثُمَّ قَالَ وَ إِنْ عَزَمُوا الطَّلاقَ فَإِنَّ اللهَ سَمِیعٌ عَلِیمٌ وَ قَالَ وَ إِنْ طائِفَتانِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ اقْتَتَلُوا فَأَصْلِحُوا بَیْنَهُما فَإِنْ بَغَتْ إِحْداهُما عَلَی الْأُخْری فَقاتِلُوا الَّتِی تَبْغِی حَتَّی تَفِیءَ إِلی أَمْرِ اللهِ أَیْ تَرْجِعَ فَإِنْ فاءَتْ أَیْ رَجَعَتْ فَأَصْلِحُوا بَیْنَهُما بِالْعَدْلِ وَ أَقْسِطُوا إِنَّ اللهَ یُحِبُّ الْمُقْسِطِینَ یَعْنِی بِقَوْلِهِ تَفِیءَ تَرْجِعَ فَذَلِکَ الدَّلِیلُ عَلَی أَنَّ الْفَیْءَ کُلُّ رَاجِعٍ إِلَی مَکَانٍ قَدْ کَانَ عَلَیْهِ أَوْ فِیهِ وَ یُقَالُ لِلشَّمْسِ إِذَا زَالَتْ قَدْ فَاءَتِ الشَّمْسُ حِینَ یَفِیءُ الْفَیْءُ عِنْدَ رُجُوعِ الشَّمْسِ إِلَی زَوَالِهَا وَ کَذَلِکَ مَا أَفَاءَ اللَّهُ عَلَی الْمُؤْمِنِینَ مِنَ الْکُفَّارِ فَإِنَّمَا هِیَ حُقُوقُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ رَجَعَتْ إِلَیْهِمْ بَعْدَ ظُلْمِ الْکُفَّارِ إِیَّاهُمْ فَذَلِکَ قَوْلُهُ أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا مَا کَانَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ أَحَقَّ بِهِ مِنْهُمْ وَ إِنَّمَا أُذِنَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِینَ الَّذِینَ قَامُوا بِشَرَائِطِ الْإِیمَانِ الَّتِی وَصَفْنَاهَا وَ ذَلِکَ أَنَّهُ لَا یَکُونُ مَأْذُوناً لَهُ فِی الْقِتَالِ حَتَّی یَکُونَ مَظْلُوماً وَ لَا یَکُونُ مَظْلُوماً حَتَّی یَکُونَ مُؤْمِناً وَ لَا یَکُونُ مُؤْمِناً حَتَّی یَکُونَ قَائِماً بِشَرَائِطِ الْإِیمَانِ الَّتِی اشْتَرَطَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَی الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ الْمُجَاهِدِینَ فَإِذَا تَکَامَلَتْ فِیهِ شَرَائِطُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ کَانَ مُؤْمِناً وَ إِذَا کَانَ مُؤْمِناً کَانَ مَظْلُوماً وَ إِذَا کَانَ مَظْلُوماً کَانَ مَأْذُوناً لَهُ فِی الْجِهَادِ لِقَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِیرٌ وَ إِنْ لَمْ یَکُنْ مُسْتَکْمِلًا لِشَرَائِطِ الْإِیمَانِ فَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ مِمَّنْ یَبْغِی وَ یَجِبُ جِهَادُهُ حَتَّی یَتُوبَ وَ لَیْسَ مِثْلُهُ مَأْذُوناً لَهُ فِی الْجِهَادِ وَ الدُّعَاءِ إِلَی اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لِأَنَّهُ لَیْسَ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ الْمَظْلُومِینَ الَّذِینَ أُذِنَ لَهُمْ فِی الْقُرْآنِ فِی الْقِتَالِ فَلَمَّا نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآیَةُ أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا فِی الْمُهَاجِرِینَ الَّذِینَ أَخْرَجَهُمْ أَهْلُ مَکَّةَ مِنْ دِیَارِهِمْ وَ أَمْوَالِهِمْ أُحِلَّ لَهُمْ جِهَادُهُمْ بِظُلْمِهِمْ إِیَّاهُمْ وَ أُذِنَ لَهُمْ فِی الْقِتَالِ فَقُلْتُ فَهَذِهِ نَزَلَتْ فِی الْمُهَاجِرِینَ بِظُلْمِ مُشْرِکِی أَهْلِ مَکَّةَ لَهُمْ فَمَا بَالُهُمْ فِی قِتَالِهِمْ کِسْرَی وَ قَیْصَرَ وَ مَنْ دُونَهُمْ مِنْ مُشْرِکِی قَبَائِلِ الْعَرَبِ فَقَالَ لَوْ کَانَ إِنَّمَا أُذِنَ لَهُمْ فِی قِتَالِ مَنْ ظَلَمَهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ مَکَّةَ فَقَطْ لَمْ یَکُنْ لَهُمْ إِلَی قِتَالِ جُمُوعِ کِسْرَی وَ قَیْصَرَ وَ غَیْرِ أَهْلِ مَکَّةَ مِنْ قَبَائِلِ الْعَرَبِ سَبِیلٌ لِأَنَّ الَّذِینَ ظَلَمُوهُمْ غَیْرُهُمْ وَ إِنَّمَا أُذِنَ لَهُمْ فِی قِتَالِ مَنْ ظَلَمَهُمْ مِنْ أَهْلِ مَکَّةَ لِإِخْرَاجِهِمْ إِیَّاهُمْ مِنْ دِیَارِهِمْ وَ أَمْوَالِهِمْ بِغَیْرِ حَقٍّ وَ لَوْ کَانَتِ الْآیَةُ إِنَّمَا عَنَتِ الْمُهَاجِرِینَ الَّذِینَ ظَلَمَهُمْ أَهْلُ مَکَّةَ کَانَتِ الْآیَةُ مُرْتَفِعَةَ الْفَرْضِ عَمَّنْ بَعْدَهُمْ إِذَا لَمْ یَبْقَ مِنَ الظَّالِمِینَ وَ الْمَظْلُومِینَ أَحَدٌ وَ کَانَ فَرْضُهَا مَرْفُوعاً عَنِ النَّاسِ بَعْدَهُمْ {إِذَا لَمْ یَبْقَ مِنَ الظَّالِمِینَ وَ الْمَظْلُومِینَ أَحَدٌ} وَ لَیْسَ کَمَا ظَنَنْتَ وَ لَا کَمَا ذَکَرْتَ وَ لَکِنَّ الْمُهَاجِرِینَ ظُلِمُوا مِنْ جِهَتَیْنِ ظَلَمَهُمْ أَهْلُ مَکَّةَ بِإِخْرَاجِهِمْ مِنْ دِیَارِهِمْ وَ أَمْوَالِهِمْ فَقَاتَلُوهُمْ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ فِی ذَلِکَ وَ ظَلَمَهُمْ کِسْرَی وَ قَیْصَرُ وَ مَنْ کَانَ دُونَهُمْ مِنْ قَبَائِلِ الْعَرَبِ وَ الْعَجَمِ بِمَا کَانَ فِی أَیْدِیهِمْ مِمَّا کَانَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ أَحَقَّ بِهِ مِنْهُمْ فَقَدْ قَاتَلُوهُمْ بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَهُمْ فِی ذَلِکَ وَ بِحُجَّةِ هَذِهِ الْآیَةِ یُقَاتِلُ مُؤْمِنُو کُلِّ زَمَانٍ وَ إِنَّمَا أَذِنَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لِلْمُؤْمِنِینَ الَّذِینَ قَامُوا بِمَا وَصَفَهَا اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مِنَ الشَّرَائِطِ الَّتِی شَرَطَهَا اللَّهُ عَلَی الْمُؤْمِنِینَ فِی الْإِیمَانِ وَ الْجِهَادِ وَ مَنْ کَانَ قَائِماً بِتِلْکَ الشَّرَائِطِ فَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ وَ هُوَ مَظْلُومٌ وَ مَأْذُونٌ لَهُ فِی الْجِهَادِ بِذَلِکَ الْمَعْنَی وَ مَنْ کَانَ عَلَی خِلَافِ ذَلِکَ فَهُوَ ظَالِمٌ وَ لَیْسَ مِنَ الْمَظْلُومِینَ وَ لَیْسَ بِمَأْذُونٍ لَهُ فِی الْقِتَالِ وَ لَا بِالنَّهْیِ عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ وَ الْأَمْرِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ لِأَنَّهُ لَیْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِ ذَلِکَ وَ لَا مَأْذُونٍ لَهُ فِی الدُّعَاءِ إِلَی اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لِأَنَّهُ لَیْسَ یُجَاهِدُ مِثْلُهُ وَ أُمِرَ بِدُعَائِهِ إِلَی اللَّهِ وَ لَا یَکُونُ مُجَاهِداً مَنْ قَدْ أُمِرَ الْمُؤْمِنُونَ بِجِهَادِهِ وَ حَظَرَ الْجِهَادَ عَلَیْهِ وَ مَنَعَهُ مِنْهُ وَ لَا یَکُونُ دَاعِیاً إِلَی اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ مَنْ أُمِرَ بِدُعَاءِ مِثْلِهِ إِلَی التَّوْبَةِ وَ الْحَقِّ وَ الْأَمْرِ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ النَّهْیِ عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ وَ لَا یَأْمُرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ مَنْ قَدْ أُمِرَ أَنْ یُؤْمَرَ بِهِ وَ لَا یَنْهَی عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ مَنْ قَدْ أُمِرَ أَنْ یُنْهَی عَنْهُ فَمَنْ کَانَتْ قَدْ تَمَّتْ فِیهِ شَرَائِطُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ الَّتِی وُصِفَ بِهَا أَهْلُهَا مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِیِّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ هُوَ مَظْلُومٌ فَهُوَ مَأْذُونٌ لَهُ فِی الْجِهَادِ کَمَا أُذِنَ لَهُمْ فِی الْجِهَادِ لِأَنَّ حُکْمَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ فِی الْأَوَّلِینَ وَ الْآخِرِینَ وَ فَرَائِضَهُ عَلَیْهِمْ سَوَاءٌ إِلَّا مِنْ عِلَّةٍ أَوْ حَادِثٍ یَکُونُ وَ الْأَوَّلُونَ وَ الْآخِرُونَ أَیْضاً فِی مَنْعِ الْحَوَادِثِ شُرَکَاءُ وَ الْفَرَائِضُ عَلَیْهِمْ وَاحِدَةٌ یُسْأَلُ الْآخِرُونَ عَنْ أَدَاءِ الْفَرَائِضِ عَمَّا یُسْأَلُ عَنْهُ الْأَوَّلُونَ وَ یُحَاسَبُونَ عَمَّا بِهِ یُحَاسَبُونَ وَ مَنْ لَمْ یَکُنْ عَلَی صِفَةِ مَنْ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ لَهُ فِی الْجِهَادِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ فَلَیْسَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْجِهَادِ وَ لَیْسَ بِمَأْذُونٍ لَهُ فِیهِ حَتَّی یَفِیءَ بِمَا شَرَطَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَیْهِ فَإِذَا تَکَامَلَتْ فِیهِ شَرَائِطُ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَی الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ الْمُجَاهِدِینَ فَهُوَ مِنَ الْمَأْذُونِینَ لَهُمْ فِی الْجِهَادِ فَلْیَتَّقِ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَبْدٌ وَ لَا یَغْتَرَّ بِالْأَمَانِیِّ الَّتِی نَهَی اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَنْهَا مِنْ هَذِهِ الْأَحَادِیثِ الْکَاذِبَةِ عَلَی اللَّهِ الَّتِی یُکَذِّبُهَا الْقُرْآنُ وَ یَتَبَرَّأُ مِنْهَا وَ مِنْ حَمَلَتِهَا وَ رُوَاتِهَا وَ لَا یَقْدَمُ عَلَی اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِشُبْهَةٍ لَا یُعْذَرُ بِهَا فَإِنَّهُ لَیْسَ وَرَاءَ الْمُتَعَرِّضِ لِلْقَتْلِ فِی سَبِیلِ اللَّهِ مَنْزِلَةٌ یُؤْتَی اللَّهُ مِنْ قِبَلِهَا وَ هِیَ غَایَةُ الْأَعْمَالِ فِی عِظَمِ قَدْرِهَا فَلْیَحْکُمِ امْرُؤٌ لِنَفْسِهِ وَ لْیُرِهَا کِتَابَ اللَّهِ عَ-زَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ یَعْرِضُ-هَا عَلَیْهِ فَإِنَّهُ لَا أَحَدَ أَعْرَفُ بِالْمَرْءِ مِنْ نَفْسِ-هِ فَإِنْ وَجَدَهَا قَائِمَةً بِمَا شَرَطَ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِ فِی الْجِهَادِ فَلْیُقْدِمْ عَلَی الْجِهَادِ وَ إِنْ عَلِمَ تَقْصِیراً فَلْیُصْلِحْهَا وَ لْیُقِمْهَا عَلَی مَا فَرَضَ اللَّهُ عَلَیْهَا مِنَ الْجِهَادِ ثُمَّ لْیُقْدِمْ بِهَا وَ هِیَ طَاهِرَةٌ مُطَهَّرَةٌ مِنْ کُلِّ دَنَسٍ یَحُولُ بَیْنَهَا وَ بَیْنَ جِهَادِهَا وَ لَسْنَا نَقُولُ لِمَنْ أَرَادَ الْجِهَادَ وَ هُوَ عَلَی خِلَافِ مَا وَصَفْنَا مِنْ شَرَائِطِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَی الْمُؤْمِنِینَ وَ الْمُجَاهِدِینَ لَا تُجَاهِدُوا وَ لَکِنْ نَقُولُ قَدْ عَلَّمْنَاکُمْ مَا شَرَطَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ عَلَی أَهْلِ الْجِهَادِ الَّذِینَ بَایَعَهُمْ وَ اشْتَرَی مِنْهُمْ أَنْفُسَهُمْ وَ أَمْوَالَهُمْ بِالْجِنَانِ فَلْیُصْلِحِ امْرُؤٌ مَا عَلِمَ مِنْ نَفْسِهِ مِنْ تَقْصِیرٍ عَنْ ذَلِکَ وَ لْیَعْرِضْهَا عَلَی شَرَائِطِ اللَّهِ فَإِنْ رَأَی أَنَّهُ قَدْ وَفَی بِهَا وَ تَکَامَلَتْ فِیهِ فَإِنَّهُ مِمَّنْ أَذِنَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ لَهُ فِی الْجِهَادِ فَإِنْ أَبَی أَنْ لَا یَکُونَ مُجَاهِداً عَلَی مَا فِیهِ مِنَ الْإِصْرَارِ عَلَی الْمَعَاصِی وَ الْمَحَارِمِ وَ الْإِقْدَامِ عَلَی الْجِهَادِ بِالتَّخْبِیطِ وَ الْعَمَی وَ الْقُدُومِ عَلَی اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ بِالْجَهْلِ وَ الرِّوَایَاتِ الْکَاذِبَةِ فَلَقَدْ لَعَمْرِی جَاءَ الْأَثَرُ فِیمَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا الْفِعْلَ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ یَنْصُرُ هَذَا الدِّینَ بِأَقْوَامٍ لَا خَلَاقَ لَهُمْ فَلْیَتَّقِ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ امْرُؤٌ وَ لْیَحْذَرْ أَنْ یَکُونَ مِنْهُمْ فَقَدْ بَیَّنَ لَکُمْ وَ لَا عُذْرَ لَکُمْ بَعْدَ الْبَیَانِ فِی الْجَهْلِ وَ لَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ وَ حَسْبُنَا اللَّهُ عَلَیْهِ تَوَکَّلْنَا وَ إِلَیْهِ الْمَصِیرُ.
39.en: Abu Amr al-Zubayri reported from Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him), who said: I said to him, "Inform me about the call to God and Jihad in His path. Is it for a people for whom it is not permissible except for them, and none may undertake it except those who are from them? Or is it permissible for everyone who declares the oneness of God, the Almighty and Majestic?" He replied, "It is for a people for whom it is not permissible except for them, and none may undertake it except those who are from them..." I said, "Explain this to me, may God have mercy on you." He said, "God, the Blessed and Exalted, informed His Prophet in His Book about the call to Him and described those who call to Him, establishing for them degrees that identify one another and serve as evidence for one another. He informed that He, the Blessed and Exalted, was the first to call to Himself and called to His obedience and the following of His command, so He began with Himself... then He followed with His Messenger, then He thirdly called to Himself through His Book. Then He mentioned those whom He permitted to call to Him after Him and after His Messenger (peace be upon him and his family) in His Book, saying: 'And let there be [arising] from you a nation inviting to [all that is] good, enjoining what is right and forbidding what is wrong, and those will be the successful' (3:104). Then He informed [us] about this nation, who they are, and that they are from the progeny of Abraham (peace be upon him) and from the progeny of Ishmael (peace be upon him), those about whom He informed in His Book that He removed impurity from them and purified them with a thorough purification. Then He mentioned the followers of His Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and the followers of this nation whom He described in His Book as enjoining the good and forbidding the evil, and He made them callers to Him and permitted them to call to Him, and He adorned them and described them so that no one would covet joining them except those who are from them... Then He informed that He has purchased from these believers, and those who are of their description, their lives and their wealth in exchange for Paradise; they fight in the path of God, so they kill and are killed—a true promise upon Him in the Torah, the Gospel, and the Quran. Then He mentioned their fulfillment of His covenant and their pledge to Him, saying: 'And who is more faithful to his covenant than God? So rejoice in your transaction which you have contracted. And it is that which is the great attainment' (9:111). When this verse was revealed, 'Indeed, God has purchased from the believers their lives and their properties [in exchange] for that they will have Paradise' (9:111), a man stood up to the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) and said, 'O Prophet of God, what do you say about a man who takes his sword and fights until he is killed, yet he commits some of these forbidden things; is he a martyr?' Then God, the Almighty and Majestic, revealed to His Messenger: 'They are the repentant, the worshippers, the praisers, the travelers [for God], the bowers, the prostrators, the enjoiners of what is right and the forbidder of what is wrong, and the keepers of the limits of God. And give good tidings to the believers' (9:112). The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) then interpreted the Mujahideen (those who struggle) from among the believers—those who possess these qualities and characteristics—with martyrdom and Paradise, and said: 'The repentant from sins, the worshippers who worship none but God and associate nothing with Him, the praisers who praise God in every state—in hardship and ease, the travelers who are the fasting ones, the bowers and prostrators who are constant in the five prayers, guarding them and maintaining them with their bowing and prostration, with humility in them and in their times, the enjoiners of the good after that, and the doers of it, and the forbidder of the evil and those who refrain from it.' He said: 'Give good tidings of martyrdom and Paradise to whoever is killed while upholding these conditions.' Then God, the Blessed and Exalted, informed that He did not command fighting except for the possessors of these conditions, saying, the Almighty and Majestic: 'Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, God is competent to give them victory. [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right—only because they say, "Our Lord is God"' (22:39-40). This is because all that is between the heavens and the earth belongs to God, the Almighty and Majestic, and to His Messenger and their followers from among the believers who possess this description. Whatever of the world was in the hands of the polytheists, the disbelievers, the oppressors, and the wicked—from those who oppose the Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) and turn away from their obedience—they oppressed the believers of these descriptions with it and overcame them regarding it, [even though it was] from what God bestowed upon His Messenger; so it is their right. God bestowed it upon them and returned it to them. The meaning of 'fay' (spoils) is everything that came to the polytheists and then returned from what they had overcome or possessed. Whatever returns to its place, whether of speech or action, has 'fa'a' (returned), like the saying of God, the Almighty and Majestic: 'For those who swear not to have sexual relations with their wives is a waiting time for four months, but if they return [fa'u], then indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful' (2:226), meaning they returned. Then He said: 'But if they resolve to divorce, then indeed, God is Hearing and Knowing' (2:227). And He said: 'And if two factions among the believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns [tafi'a] to the command of God' (49:9), meaning returns. 'Then if it returns [fa'at]'—that is, returned—'make settlement between them in justice and act equitably. Indeed, God loves the equitable.' He means by His saying 'tafi'a', to return. This is the evidence that 'fay' is everything returning to a place it was previously upon or in. It is said of the sun when it passes the meridian, 'The sun has fa'at,' when the shadow returns at the sun's return to its decline. Likewise, what God has returned to the believers from the disbelievers is only the rights of the believers that returned to them after the oppression of the disbelievers against them. That is His saying: 'Permission has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged.' The believers were not more entitled to it than them, and permission was only given to the believers who upheld the conditions of faith that we have described. This is because one is not permitted to fight until he is wronged, and he is not wronged until he is a believer, and he is not a believer until he is upholding the conditions of faith that God, the Almighty and Majestic, has stipulated upon the believers and the Mujahideen. When the conditions of God, the Almighty and Majestic, are complete in him, he is a believer; when he is a believer, he is wronged; and when he is wronged, he is permitted to engage in Jihad, due to His saying, the Almighty and Majestic: 'Permission has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, God is competent to give them victory.' If he is not complete in the conditions of faith, he is an oppressor from among those who transgress, and it is obligatory to struggle against him until he repents. Such a person is not permitted to engage in Jihad or the call to God, the Almighty and Majestic, because he is not among the wronged believers who were permitted to fight in the Quran. When this verse was revealed, 'Permission has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged,' regarding the Emigrants whom the people of Mecca drove out of their homes and properties, their Jihad against them was made lawful due to their oppression of them, and they were permitted to fight. I said, 'So this was revealed regarding the Emigrants due to the oppression of the polytheists of Mecca against them. What then of their fighting against Chosroes, Caesar, and those below them from the polytheist tribes of the Arabs?' He said, 'If permission had only been given to them to fight those who oppressed them from the people of Mecca specifically, they would have had no way to fight the armies of Chosroes, Caesar, and others besides the people of Mecca from the Arab tribes, because those who oppressed them were others. Permission was only given to them to fight those who oppressed them from the people of Mecca for driving them out of their homes and properties without right. If the verse only meant the Emigrants whom the people of Mecca oppressed, the obligation of the verse would have been lifted from those after them when no one remained of the oppressors and the oppressed, and its obligation would have been lifted from the people after them. But it is not as you thought, nor as you mentioned. Rather, the Emigrants were oppressed from two sides: the people of Mecca oppressed them by driving them out of their homes and properties, so they fought them with the permission of God for them in that; and Chosroes, Caesar, and those below them from the tribes of the Arabs and non-Arabs oppressed them by what was in their hands from what the believers were more entitled to than them, so they fought them with the permission of God, the Almighty and Majestic, for them in that. By the argument of this verse, the believers of every time fight. God, the Almighty and Majestic, only permitted the believers who upheld what God, the Almighty and Majestic, described of the conditions He stipulated upon the believers regarding faith and Jihad. Whoever is upholding those conditions is a believer, is wronged, and is permitted to engage in Jihad by that meaning. Whoever is contrary to that is an oppressor, is not among the wronged, and is not permitted to fight, nor to forbid the evil and enjoin the good, because he is not of the people of that, nor is he permitted to call to God, the Almighty and Majestic, because one like him does not struggle, and he has been commanded to be called to God, and one who has been commanded to be struggled against by the believers cannot be a Mujahid, and one who has been commanded to be called to repentance, truth, enjoining the good, and forbidding the evil cannot be a caller to God, the Almighty and Majestic. One who has been commanded to be enjoined cannot enjoin the good, and one who has been commanded to be forbidden cannot forbid the evil. So whoever has completed in him the conditions of God, the Almighty and Majestic, which the people of it—the companions of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family)—were described with, and he is wronged, then he is permitted to engage in Jihad, just as they were permitted to engage in Jihad, because the judgment of God, the Almighty and Majestic, regarding the first and the last, and His obligations upon them, are the same, except for a cause or an incident that occurs. The first and the last are also partners in the prevention of incidents, and the obligations upon them are one. The last will be asked about the performance of the obligations just as the first are asked, and they will be held accountable for what they are held accountable for. Whoever is not of the description of those whom God permitted to engage in Jihad from among the believers is not of the people of Jihad, and is not permitted to engage in it until he returns to what God, the Almighty and Majestic, has stipulated upon him. When the conditions of God, the Almighty and Majestic, upon the believers and the Mujahideen are complete in him, he is among those permitted to engage in Jihad. So let the servant fear God, the Almighty and Majestic, and not be deceived by the wishes that God, the Almighty and Majestic, has forbidden from these false hadiths against God, which the Quran denies and disavows, as well as their carriers and narrators. And let him not approach God, the Almighty and Majestic, with a doubt for which he will not be excused, for there is no station beyond the one who exposes himself to being killed in the path of God by which one is brought to God, and it is the ultimate of deeds in the greatness of its value. Let a person judge for himself and show himself the Book of God, the Almighty and Majestic, and present himself to it, for no one is more knowledgeable of a person than his own self. If he finds himself upholding what God has stipulated upon him regarding Jihad, then let him proceed to Jihad. If he knows of a shortcoming, let him reform it and establish it upon what God has obligated upon it regarding Jihad, then let him proceed with it while it is pure and purified from every filth that stands between it and its Jihad. We do not say to one who desires Jihad while he is contrary to what we have described of the conditions of God, the Almighty and Majestic, upon the believers and the Mujahideen, 'Do not struggle,' but we say: We have taught you what God, the Almighty and Majestic, has stipulated upon the people of Jihad, those with whom He has contracted and purchased from them their lives and wealth in exchange for Paradise. So let a person reform what he knows of himself of shortcoming regarding that, and let him present himself to the conditions of God. If he sees that he has fulfilled them and they are complete in him, then he is among those whom God, the Almighty and Majestic, has permitted to engage in Jihad. If he refuses to be a Mujahid while he persists in sins and forbidden things, and proceeds to Jihad in confusion and blindness, and approaches God, the Almighty and Majestic, with ignorance and false narrations, then by my life, the report has come regarding whoever does this deed: 'Indeed, God, the Almighty and Majestic, supports this religion with people who have no share [in it].' So let a person fear God, the Almighty and Majestic, and beware of being among them, for it has been made clear to you, and you have no excuse after the clarification regarding ignorance. And there is no power except by God, and God is sufficient for us; upon Him we have relied, and to Him is the destination."
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 670
39.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 5, p. 15; Tahdhib al-Ahkam, Vol. 6, p. 129; Wasa'il al-Shi'a, Vol. 15, p. 36; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Mustadrak al-Wasa'il, Vol. 11, p. 124

39.ar: قَالَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) فِی ذِکْرِ النَّاسِخِ وَ الْمَنْسُوخِ وَ مِنْهُ أَنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَکَ وَ تَعَالَی لَمَّا بَعَثَ مُحَمَّداً (صلی الله علیه و آله) أَمَرَهُ فِی بَدْءِ أَمْرِهِ أَنْ یَدْعُوَ بِالدَّعْوَةِ فَقَطْ وَ أَنْزَلَ عَلَیْهِ یا أَیُّهَا النَّبِیُّ إِنَّا أَرْسَلْناکَ شاهِداً وَ مُبَشِّراً وَ نَذِیراً* وَ داعِیاً إِلَی اللهِ بِإِذْنِهِ وَ سِراجاً مُنِیراً* وَ بَشِّرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ بِأَنَّ لَهُمْ مِنَ اللهِ فَضْلًا کَبِیراً* وَ لا تُطِعِ الْکافِرِینَ وَ الْمُنافِقِینَ وَ دَعْ أَذاهُمْ وَ تَوَکَّلْ عَلَی اللهِ وَ کَفی بِاللهِ وَکِیلًا فَبَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ بِالدَّعْوَةِ فَقَطْ وَ أَمَرَهُ أَنْ لَا یُؤْذِیَهُمْ فَلَمَّا أَرَادُوهُ بِمَا هَمُّوا بِهِ مِنْ تَبْیِیتٍ أَمَرَهُ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی بِالْهِجْرَةِ وَ فَرَضَ عَلَیْهِ الْقِتَالَ فَقَالَ سُبْحَانَهُ أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِیرٌ. فَلَمَّا أَمَرَ النَّاسَ بِالْحَرْبِ جَزِعُوا وَ خَافُوا فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَی أَ لَمْ تَرَ إِلَی الَّذِینَ قِیلَ لَهُمْ کُفُّوا أَیْدِیَکُمْ وَ أَقِیمُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ آتُوا الزَّکاةَ فَلَمَّا کُتِبَ عَلَیْهِمُ الْقِتالُ إِذا فَرِیقٌ مِنْهُمْ یَخْشَوْنَ النَّاسَ کَخَشْیَةِ اللهِ أَوْ أَشَدَّ خَشْیَةً وَ قالُوا رَبَّنا لِمَ کَتَبْتَ عَلَیْنَا الْقِتالَ لَوْ لا أَخَّرْتَنا إِلی أَجَلٍ قَرِیبٍ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ سُبْحَانَهُ أَیْنَما تَکُونُوا یُدْرِکْکُمُ الْمَوْتُ وَ لَوْ کُنْتُمْ فِی بُرُوجٍ مُشَیَّدَةٍ فَنَسَخَتْ آیَةُ الْقِتَالِ آیَةَ الْکَف.
39.en: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said regarding the abrogating and abrogated verses: "Among them is that when Allah, Blessed and Exalted is He, sent Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), He commanded him at the beginning of his mission to only call [people to Islam] through invitation. He revealed to him: 'O Prophet, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner. And one who invites to Allah, by His permission, and an illuminating lamp. And give good tidings to the believers that they will have from Allah a great bounty. And do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and disregard their annoyance, and rely upon Allah. And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.' So Allah sent him with the invitation only, and commanded him not to harm them. When they intended against him what they plotted—a night attack—Allah, the Exalted, commanded him to migrate and made fighting obligatory upon him. He, the Glorified, said: 'Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory.' When he commanded the people to fight, they became impatient and afraid. So Allah, the Exalted, revealed: 'Have you not seen those who were told, "Restrain your hands [from fighting] and establish prayer and give zakah"? But then when fighting was written for them, at once a party of them feared the people as they fear Allah or with [even] greater fear. And they said, "Our Lord, why have You decreed upon us fighting? If only You had postponed it for us for a short time,"' up to His saying, the Glorified: 'Wherever you may be, death will overtake you, even if you should be within towers of lofty construction.' Thus, the verse of fighting abrogated the verse of restraint."
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 678
39.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 19, p. 175; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 90, p. 6; Wasa'il al-Shi'ah, Vol. 15, p. 85; "Inna Allah 'ala nasrihim... law kuntum fi buruj" is omitted.

39.ar: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِیرٌ؛ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِی عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) وَ حَمْزَةَ (رحمة الله علیه) وَ جَعْفَرٍ (رحمة الله علیه) ثُمَّ جَرَتْ فِی الْحُسَیْنِ (علیه السلام).
39.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- آیه: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِیر؛ در شأن علی (حمزه (و جعفر طیّار (نازل شد، سپس [در مورد دیگران] جریان پیدا کرد.
39.en: "Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory." He said: It was revealed concerning Ali (peace be upon him), Hamza (may Allah have mercy upon him), and Ja'far (may Allah have mercy upon him), and then it continued [to apply] to al-Husayn (peace be upon him).
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 680
39.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 22, p. 278 / al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 84 / Nur al-Thaqalayn

39.ar: عَنْ أَبِی خَالِدٍ الْکَابُلِیِّ عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) قَال سَمِعْتُهُ یَقُولُ فِی قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِیرٌ؛ قَالَ عَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام) وَ الْحَسَنُ (علیه السلام) وَ الْحُسَیْنُ (علیه السلام).
39.fa: امام باقر (- ابوخالد کابلی گوید: از امام باقر (شنیدم که در مورد این سخن خداوند عزّوجلّ [که فرموده:] أُذِنَ لِلَّذینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدیرٌ؛ می‌فرمود: «منظور، امام علی (امام حسن (و امام حسین (می‌باشد».
39.en: From Abu Khalid al-Kabuli, from Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him), who said: I heard him saying regarding the words of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: "Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory" (22:39); he said: "It refers to Ali (peace be upon him), al-Hasan (peace be upon him), and al-Husayn (peace be upon him)."
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 680
39.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 45, p. 297; Kamil al-Ziyarat, p. 63; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 227; Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahirah, p. 334; al-Burhan

39.ar: عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) فِی قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِیرٌ قَالَ الْحُسَیْنُ (علیه السلام).
39.fa: امام باقر (- از امامباقر (نقل‌شده که در مورد این سخن خداوند عزّوجلّ [که می‌فرماید:] أُذِنَ لِلَّذینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدیرٌ؛ فرمود: «منظور امام حسین (است».
39.en: From Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him) regarding the saying of Allah, the Exalted and Majestic: "Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory." He said: "It refers to al-Husayn (peace be upon him)."
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 680

39.ar: وَ کَذَلِکَ مَثَلُ الْقَائِمِ (عجل الله تعالی فرجه الشریف) فِی غَیْبَتِهِ وَ هَرَبِهِ وَ اسْتِتَارِهِ مَثَلُ مُوسَی (علیه السلام) خَائِفٌ مُسْتَتِرٌ إِلَی أَنْ یَأْذَنَ اللَّهُ فِی خُرُوجِهِ وَ طَلَبِ حَقِّهِ وَ قَتْلِ أَعْدَائِهِ فِی قَوْلِهِ أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِیرٌ الَّذِینَ أُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِیارِهِمْ بِغَیْرِ حَقٍّ وَ قَدْ ضَرَبَ بِالْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) مَثَلًا فِی بَنِی إِسْرَائِیلَ بِإِدَالَتِهِمْ مِنْ أَعْدَائِهِمْ.
39.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- حضرت قائم (در غیبت! گریزان‌بودن و پنهان‌زیستن همچون حضرت‌موسی (است؛ او پیوسته ترسان و پنهان خواهد بود تا زمانی‌که خداوند به او اجازه‌ی ظهور، مطالبه‌ی حقّ و کشتن دشمنانش را بدهد، همچنان‌که در این آیه فرموده: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِیرٌ * الَّذِینَ أُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِیارِهِمْ بِغَیْرِ حَقٍّ.
39.en: The likeness of the Qa'im (may Allah hasten his noble reappearance) in his occultation, his flight, and his concealment is the likeness of Moses (peace be upon him); he is fearful and concealed until Allah grants him permission for his emergence, the seeking of his right, and the killing of his enemies, as per His saying: "Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory. [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right." And He has set forth the example of al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him) among the Children of Israel regarding their triumph over their enemies.
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 680
39.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 168; al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 134; "bidhalatihim" is a variant for "bi-idalatihim"

39.ar: عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) فِی قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِیرٌ قَالَ هِیَ فِی الْقَائِمِ (عجل الله تعالی فرجه الشریف) وَ أَصْحَابِهِ.
39.fa: امام باقر (- از امامباقر (نقل‌شده که در مورد این سخن خداوند عزّوجلّ [که فرموده:] أُذِنَ لِلَّذینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدیرٌ؛ فرمود: «این آیه در مورد حضرت قائم (و یارانش نازل شده است».
39.en: From Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him) regarding the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: "Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory." He said: "It is regarding the Qa’im (may Allah hasten his noble reappearance) and his companions."
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 680
39.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 227; Ta’wil al-Ayat al-Zahira, p. 334; Al-Burhan; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 51, p. 58; Al-Ghaybah by al-Nu’mani, p. 241

39.ar: عَنْ أَبِی عَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) فِی قَوْلِهِ أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِیرٌ قَالَ إِنَّ الْعَامَّةَ یَقُولُونَ نَزَلَتْ فِی رَسُول اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) لَمَّا أَخْرَجَتْهُ قُرَیْشٌ مِنْ مَکَّةَ وَ إِنَّمَا هُوَ الْقَائِمُ (عجل الله تعالی فرجه الشریف) إِذَا خَرَجَ یَطْلُبُ بِدَمِ الْحُسَیْنِ (علیه السلام) وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ نَحْنُ أَوْلِیَاءُ الدَّمِ وَ طُلَّابُ التِّرَةِ (الدِّیَةِ).
39.fa: امام صادق (- از امامصادق (نقل‌شده که در مورد این سخن خداوند عزّوجلّ [که فرموده:] أُذِنَ لِلَّذینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدیرٌ؛ فرمود: «اهل سنّت معتقدند که این آیه در مورد رسول خدا (در آن هنگام که قریش ایشان را از مکّه بیرون راندند، نازل شده است؛ در حالی‌که منظور آیه، حضرت قائم (است؛ در آن‌هنگام‌که ظهور کرده و خونخواهی حسین (نماید، گوید: «ما اولیای دم و خواهان دیه[ی امام‌حسین (] هستیم».
39.en: Regarding the saying of Allah, "Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory," Abu ‘Abd Allah (peace be upon him) said: "The general public (the Sunnis) say that this was revealed concerning the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) when the Quraysh drove him out of Mecca. In reality, it refers to the Qa’im (may Allah hasten his noble reappearance) when he rises to seek vengeance for the blood of al-Husayn (peace be upon him). This is the meaning of his saying: 'We are the guardians of the blood and the seekers of the retribution (the blood money).'"
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 680
39.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 51, p. 47; Al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 84; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan; "Talab" as a variant for "Tullab".

39.ar: نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآیَةُ فِی آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ (خَاصَّةً أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدِیرٌ الَّذِینَ أُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِیارِهِمْ بِغَیْرِ حَقٍّ إِلَّا أَنْ یَقُولُوا رَبُّنَا اللهُ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ وَ للهِ عاقِبَةُ الْأُمُورِ.
39.fa: امام باقر (- این آیه فقط درباره‌ی آل‌محمّد (نازل شده است: أُذِنَ لِلَّذینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا وَ إِنَّ اللهَ عَلی نَصْرِهِمْ لَقَدیرٌ * الَّذینَ أُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِیارِهِمْ بِغَیْرِ حَقٍّ إِلاَّ أَنْ یَقُولُوا رَبُّنَا الله؛ سپس امام باقر (ادامه این آیات را تا وَ لِلهِ عاقِبَةُ الْأُمُور تلاوت فرمود.
39.en: This verse was revealed specifically regarding the Family of Muhammad: "Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, Allah is competent to give them victory. [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right - only because they say, 'Our Lord is Allah.'" Then, Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) recited the remainder of these verses up to: "And to Allah belongs the outcome of [all] matters."
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 682
39.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 226; Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahirah, p. 333; Al-Burhan

39.ar: قَالَ ابْنُ حَازِمٍ التَّمِیمِیُّ وَ أَبُووَائِلٍ قَالَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) خَرَجَ الْفَرَازُ بْنُ الْأَدْهَمِ وَ دَعَا الْعَبَّاسَ بْنَ رَبِیعَةَ بْنِ الْحَارِثِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْمُطَّلِبِ فَقَتَلَهُ الْعَبَّاسُ فَنَهَاهُ عَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام) عَنِ الْمُبَارَزَةِ فَقَالَ مُعَاوِیَةُ مَنْ قَتَلَ الْعَبَّاسَ فَلَهُ عِنْدِی مَا یَشَاءُ فَخَرَجَ رَجُلَانِ لَخْمِیَّانِ فَدَعَاهُ أَحَدُهُمَا فَقَالَ إِنْ أَذِنَ لِی سَیِّدِی أُبَارِزُکَ وَ أَتَی عَلِیّاً (علیه السلام) فَبَرَزَ عَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام) فِی سِلَاحِ الْعَبَّاسِ وَ فَرَسِهِ مُتَنَکِّراً فَقَالَ الرَّجُلُ آذَنَکَ سَیِّدُکَ فَقَالَ (علیه السلام) أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا؛ فَقَتَلَه.
39.fa: امام علی (- ابن‌حازم تمیمی گوید: [در جریان جنگ صفّین] فراز بنادهم بهطرف میدان جنگ آمد و عبّاس‌بن‌ربِیعهًْ‌بن‌حارث‌بن‌عبدالمطّب را [به مبارزه] طلبید. [پس از اندکی مبارزه] عبّاس او را به هلاکت رساند. امام علی (عبّاس را از نبرد[ی دیگر] نهیکرد. معاویه گفت: «هرکس عبّاس را بکشد هرچه بخواهد به او میدهم». دو مرد از اهالی لَخْم (نام منطقه‌ای از یمن) به میدان مبارزه رفتند و یکی از آن‌ها عباس را [به مبارزه] طلبید. عباس گفت: «اگر آقایم اجازه دهد با تو مبارزه میکنم» و نزد امام‌علی (آمد. امام (لباس‌جنگی عباس را بر تن کرده و سوار بر اسب او به‌طوری‌که شناخته نشود وارد میدان شد. آن مرد گفت: «آقایت اجازه داد»؟! امام (فرمود: «أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا» و او را به هلاکت رساند.
39.en: Ibn Hazim al-Tamimi and Abu Wa'il said: Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) said: "Al-Faraz ibn al-Adham came out and challenged al-Abbas ibn Rabi'ah ibn al-Harith ibn Abd al-Muttalib, and al-Abbas killed him. Ali (peace be upon him) forbade him from [further] dueling. Mu'awiyah said, 'Whoever kills al-Abbas shall have whatever he wishes from me.' Two men from the Lakhm tribe came out, and one of them challenged him. He [al-Abbas] said, 'If my master permits me, I will duel you,' and he went to Ali (peace be upon him). Ali (peace be upon him) went out [to the field] wearing the armor of al-Abbas and riding his horse, disguised. The man said, 'Has your master permitted you?' He (peace be upon him) replied, 'Permission has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged' (22:39), and he killed him."
39.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 682
39.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 32, p. 582; al-Manaqib, Vol. 3, p. 176

40.ar: نَزَلَتْ فِی رَسُول اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) وَ حَمْزَةَ (رحمة الله علیه) وَ جَعْفَرٍ (رحمة الله علیه) وَ جَرَتْ فِی الْحُسَیْنِ (علیه السلام) أَجْمَعِینَ.
40.fa: امام باقر (- سلّام‌بن‌مستنیر گوید: امام باقر (درباره‌ی این کلام خداوند تبارک‌وتعالی: الَّذینَ أُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِیارِهِمْ بِغَیْرِ حَقٍّ إِلاَّ أَنْ یَقُولُوا رَبُّنَا اللهُ؛ فرمود: «این آیه در شأن رسول‌خدا (امام علی (حمزه (و جعفر (نازل شد و در مورد امام‌حسین (نیز جریان پیدا کرد؛ سلام بر همه‌ی آنان باد».
40.en: It was revealed concerning the Messenger of Allah (peace and blessings of Allah be upon him and his family), Ali (peace be upon him), Hamza (may Allah have mercy on him), and Ja’far (may Allah have mercy on him), and it applies to Al-Husayn (peace be upon him) as well—peace be upon them all.
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 682
40.refs: Al-Kafi, Vol. 8, p. 337; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 36, p. 146; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Al-Burhan; Ta’wil al-Ayat al-Zahira, p. 335; Shawahid al-Tanzil, Vol. 1, p. 521

40.ar: نَزَلَ فِی عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) وَ جَعْفَرٍ (رحمة الله علیه) وَ حَمْزَةَ (رحمة الله علیه) وَ جَرَتْ فِی الْحُسَیْنِ بْنِ عَلِیٍّ (علیه السلام) وَ التَّحِیَّةُ وَ الْإِکْرَامُ.
40.fa: امام صادق (- این آیه در شأن امام‌علی (جعفر (و حمزه (نازل شد و در مورد امامحسین (نیز جریان پیدا کرد؛ سلام و درود و بر آنان باد.
40.en: This was revealed regarding Ali (peace be upon him), Ja'far (may God have mercy on him), and Hamza (may God have mercy on him), and it also applies to al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him); and upon them be greetings and honor.
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 682
40.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 44, p. 219; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 22, p. 282; and Furat al-Kufi, p. 273; [with slight variations].

40.ar: وَ قَوْلُهُ الَّذِینَ أُخْرِجُوا؛ الْآیَةَ قَالَ الْحُسَیْنُ (علیه السلام).
40.fa: علیّ‌بن‌ابراهیم (- منظور آیه‌ی الَّذینَ أُخْرِجُوا...؛ امام حسین (است، در آن‌هنگام که یزید به دنبال امام (فرستاد تا حضرت را [برای بیعت‌کردن] مجبور به رفتن به شام کند و حضرت به کوفه رفت و در کربلا به شهادت رسید.
40.en: Regarding His saying, "Those who have been driven out..." [the verse], he said: It refers to al-Husayn (peace be upon him), at the time when Yazid sent for the Imam (peace be upon him) to force him to go to Damascus [to pledge allegiance], and the Imam went to Kufa and was martyred in Karbala.
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 682
40.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 223; al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 84; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Burhan

40.ar: عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) الَّذِینَ أُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِیارِهِمْ قَالَ نَزَلَتْ فِینَا.
40.fa: امام باقر (- آیه: الَّذینَ أُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِیارِهِمْ بِغَیْرِ حَقٍّ؛ در مورد ما (اهل‌بیت () نازل شده است.
40.en: Regarding the verse, "Those who have been expelled from their homes," he (peace be upon him) said: "It was revealed concerning us."
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 682
40.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 221; al-Manaqib, Vol. 4, p. 179; Nur al-Thaqalayn; Shawahid al-Tanzil, Vol. 1, p. 521

40.ar: نَزَلَتْ فِینَا خَاصَّةً فِی أَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) وَ ذُرِّیَّتِهِ (وَ مَا ارْتَکَبَ مِنْ أَمْرِ فَاطِمَةَ (سلام الله علیها).
40.fa: امام صادق (- در مورد این سخن خداوند عزّوجلّ [که می‌فرماید:] الَّذینَ أُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِیارِهِمْ بِغَیْرِ حَقٍّ؛ امام صادق (فرمود: «این آیه فقط در مورد ما یعنی امیرالمؤمنین (و فرزندان او (و در مورد جنایاتی‌که درباره‌ی حضرت فاطمه (انجام پذیرفت، نازل شده است».
40.en: It was revealed specifically concerning us, regarding the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) and his progeny, and what was committed regarding the affair of Fatimah (peace be upon her).
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 684
40.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 226; Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahirah, p. 335; Al-Burhan.

40.ar: قَالَ أَبُوجَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) نَزَلَتْ فِی الْمُهَاجِرِینَ وَ جَرَتْ فِی آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ (الَّذِینَ أُخْرِجُوا مِنْ دِیارِهِمْ وَ أُخِیفُوا.
40.fa: امام باقر (- این آیه درباره‌ی مهاجرین نازل شد و در مورد آل‌محمّد ([نیز] جریان پیدا کرد، همان‌ها که از خانهها [و شهر] خود، به ناحقّ رانده شدند و [دشمنانشان] در دل آن‌ها ترس و وحشت افکندند.
40.en: Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said: "It was revealed concerning the Emigrants (Muhajirun), and it applies to the Family of Muhammad (the ones who were driven out of their homes and were made to fear)."
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 684
40.refs: Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahirah, p. 333; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Burhan

40.ar: نَزَلَتْ هَذِهِ الْآیَةُ أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا فِی الْمُهَاجِرِینَ الَّذِینَ أَخْرَجَهُمْ أَهْلُ مَکَّةَ مِنْ دِیَارِهِمْ وَ أَمْوَالِهِمْ أُحِلَّ لَهُمْ جِهَادُهُمْ بِظُلْمِهِمْ إِیَّاهُمْ وَ أُذِنَ لَهُمْ فِی الْقِتَالِ.
40.fa: امام صادق (- آیه: أُذِنَ لِلَّذِینَ یُقاتَلُونَ بِأَنَّهُمْ ظُلِمُوا؛ درباره‌ی مهاجرین که اهل مکّه آنان را از شهر و دارایی‌هایشان بیرون راندند، نازل شد و به‌خاطر ستمی که اهل‌مکّه بر آنان روا می‌داشتند جهاد با آنان برای مهاجرین حلال گردید و به ایشان اذن پیکار داده شد.
40.en: This verse, "Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged," was revealed regarding the Emigrants (Muhajirun) whom the people of Mecca drove out of their homes and properties. Jihad against them was made lawful for them because of the injustice the people of Mecca had committed against them, and they were granted permission to fight.
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 684

40.ar: الصَّلَواتُ: کَنائِسُ الیَهُود وَ یُسَمُّونَهَا صَلوتا فَعَرَّبَ.
40.fa: ابن‌عبّاس (- منظور از «صلوات» معبدهای یهودیان است که [در زبان عِبْری] به آن‌ها «صَلُوتا» می‌گویند و در زبان عربی به‌صورت «صلوات» در آمده است.
40.en: "Salawat" refers to the synagogues of the Jews; they call them "Saluta," which has been Arabized [as "Salawat"].
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 684

40.ar: عَنْ عِیسَی بْنِ دَاوُدَ عَنْ أَبِی الْحَسَنِ مُوسَی بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) عَنْ أَبِیهِ (علیه السلام) فِی قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ لَوْ لا دَفْعُ اللهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لَهُدِّمَتْ صَوامِعُ وَ بِیَعٌ وَ صَلَواتٌ وَ مَساجِدُ یُذْکَرُ فِیهَا اسْمُ اللهِ کَثِیراً؛ قَالَ هُمُ الْأَئِمَّةُ (وَ هُمُ الْأَعْلَامُ وَ لَوْ لَا صَبْرُهُمْ وَ انْتِظَارُهُمُ الْأَمْرَ أَنْ یَأْتِیَهُمْ مِنَ اللَّهِ لَقُتِلُوا جَمِیعاً قَالَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ وَ لَیَنْصُرَنَّ اللهُ مَنْ یَنْصُرُهُ إِنَّ اللهَ لَقَوِیٌّ عَزِیزٌ.
40.fa: امام صادق (- امام‌کاظم (در مورد این سخن خداوند عزّوجلّ [که می‌فرماید:] وَ لَوْ لا دَفْعُ اللهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ لَهُدِّمَتْ صَوامِعُ وَ بِیَعٌ وَ صَلَواتٌ وَ مَساجِدُ یُذْکَرُ فیهَا اسْمُ اللهِ کَثیراً؛ از پدر بزرگوارش امام‌صادق (روایت نموده که فرمود: «منظور آیه، امامان (هستند که پیشوایان امّت می‌باشند؛ و اگر شکیبایی [در راه خدا] و انتظار فرج از جانب خدا را نداشتند [هرکدام بر ضدّ ستمگران قیام کرده و] به‌همراه تعداد زیادی از مردم کشته می‌شدند [و این‌کار باعث تعطیلی مساجد، معابد... می‌شد] خداوند عزّوجلّ فرموده است: وَ لَیَنْصُرَنَّ اللهُ مَنْ یَنْصُرُهُ إِنَّ اللهَ لَقَوِیٌّ عَزیزٌ.
40.en: From Isa ibn Dawud, from Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja’far (peace be upon him), from his father (peace be upon him), regarding the words of the Almighty and Exalted: "And were it not that Allah checks one people by means of another, there would surely have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of Allah is much mentioned." He said: "They are the Imams, and they are the beacons. Were it not for their patience and their waiting for the command to come to them from Allah, they would all have been killed." Allah the Almighty and Exalted says: "And Allah will surely support those who support Him. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might."
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 684
40.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 359; Ta’wil al-Ayat al-Zahirah, p. 336; Al-Burhan; "Allah ... Exalted in Might" is omitted.

40.ar: أَیُّهَا النَّاس ... إِنَّ اللَّهَ قَدْ فَرَضَ عَلَیْکُمْ جِهَادَ أَهْلِ الْبَغْیِ وَ الْعُدْوَانِ مِنْ أُمَّتِکُمْ عَلَی بَغْیِهِمْ وَ فَرَضَ نُصْرَةَ أَوْلِیَائِهِ الدَّاعِینَ إِلَی اللَّهِ وَ إِلَی کِتَابِهِ قَالَ وَ لَیَنْصُرَنَّ اللهُ مَنْ یَنْصُرُهُ إِنَّ اللهَ لَقَوِیٌّ عَزِیز.
40.fa: امام علی (- خدا پیکار با ستمگران و ستیزه‌جویان را به واسطه ستمگریشان لازم شمرده و کمک به داعیان حق که دعوت به خدا و قرآن می کنند را واجب نموده. در قرآن می فرماید: وَ لَیَنْصُرَنَّ اللهُ مَنْ یَنْصُرُهُ إِنَّ اللهَ لَقَوِیٌّ عَزِیزٌ.
40.en: O people... Verily, Allah has obligated upon you the jihad against the people of transgression and aggression from among your nation due to their transgression, and He has obligated the support of His allies who call to Allah and to His Book. He said: "And Allah will surely support those who support Him. Indeed, Allah is Powerful and Exalted in Might."
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 684
40.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 46, p. 206 / Furat al-Kufi, p. 135

40.ar: عَنْ حُمْرَانَ عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) قَالَ: سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ قَوْلِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَ وَ لَوْ لا دَفْعُ اللهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ إِلَی آخِرِ الْآیَةِ فَقَالَ کَانَ قَوْمٌ صَالِحُونَ وَ هُمْ مُهَاجِرُونَ مِنْ قَوْمٍ سُوءٍ خَوْفاً أَنْ یُفْسِدُوهُمْ فَیَدْفَعُ اللَّهُ أَیْدِیَهُمْ عَنِ الصَّالِحِینَ وَ لَمْ یَأْجُرْ أُولَئِکَ بِمَا یَدْفَعُ بِهِمْ وَ فِینَا مِثْلَهُمْ.
40.fa: امام باقر (- حُمران گوید: «از امامباقر (درباره‌ی این‌سخن خداوند عزّوجلّ [که فرموده:] وَ لَوْ لا دَفْعُ اللهِ النَّاسَ بَعْضَهُمْ بِبَعْضٍ ...؛ سؤال کردم». حضرت فرمود: «مردمانی نیکوکار از بیم این‌که مبادا مردم بدکار، [دین] آن‌ها را به تباهی بکشانند، از جمع آن‌ها کنارهگیری می‌کردند و خداوند به‌وسیله‌ی همان قوم بدکار [در مقابل کافران] از نیک-وکاران دفاع می‌ک-رد بدون این-که آن بدکاران در مقابل این‌کارشان پاداشی داشته باشند؛ و در میان ما نیز این جریان وجود دارد» (یعنی پیوسته خداوند به‌وسیله‌ی دشمنان اهل‌بیت مانند بنی‌امیّه و بنی‌عباس در مقابل کافران از اهل‌بیت (دفاع می‌کند).
40.en: Humran narrated from Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him), who said: I asked him about the saying of Allah, the Almighty and Majestic: "And were it not for Allah checking some people by means of others..." (to the end of the verse). He replied: "There were righteous people who were emigrants from a wicked people, fearing that they would corrupt them. So Allah would restrain their hands from the righteous, and He did not reward those [wicked ones] for that by which He repelled [the enemy] through them. And among us, there is the like of them." (Meaning: Allah continuously defends the Ahl al-Bayt against the disbelievers through the enemies of the Ahl al-Bayt, such as the Banu Umayya and the Banu Abbas).
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 684
40.refs: Ta’wil al-Ayat al-Zahira, p. 336 / Al-Burhan; "Qayyada Allah" (Allah restrained) instead of "Fayadfa’u Allah" (So Allah repels), and "Yaq’u bihim" (He falls upon them) instead of "Yadfa’u bihim" (He repels through them).

40.ar: فِی کِتَابِ النُّبُوَّةِ عَنْ زَیْنِ الْعَابِدِینَ (علیه السلام) أَنَّهُ اجْتَمَعَتْ قُرَیْشٌ إِلَی أَبِی طَالِبٍ (رحمة الله علیه) ... فَقَالَ المُطْعِمُ بْنُ عَدِیٍّ وَ اللَّهِ یَا بَاطَالِبٍ (رحمة الله علیه) لَقَدْ أَنْصَفَکَ قَوْمُکَ وَ جَهَدُوا عَلَی أَنْ یَتَخَلَّصُوا مِمَّا تَکْرَهُهُ فَمَا أَرَاکَ تُرِیدُ أَنْ تَقْبَلَ مِنْهُمْ شَیْئاً فَقَالَ أَبُوطَالِبٍ (رحمة الله علیه) وَ اللَّهِ مَا أَنْصَفُونِی وَ لَکِنَّکَ قَدْ أَجْمَعْتَ عَلَی خِذْلَانِی وَ مُظَاهَرَةِ الْقَوْمِ عَلَیَّ فَاصْنَعْ مَا بَدَا لَکَ فَوَثَبَ کُلُّ قَبِیلَةٍ عَلَی مَا فِیهَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِینَ یُعَذِّبُونَهُمْ وَ یَفْتِنُونَهُمْ عَنْ دِینِهِمْ وَ الِاسْتِهْزَاءِ بِالنَّبِیِّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ مَنَعَ اللَّهُ رَسُولَهُ بِعَمِّهِ أَبِی طَالِبٍ مِنْهُمْ وَ قَدْ قَامَ أَبُوطَالِبٍ (رحمة الله علیه) حِینَ رَأَی قُرَیْشاً تَصْنَعُ مَا تَصْنَعُ فِی بَنِی هَاشِمٍ فَدَعَاهُمْ إِلَی مَا هُوَ عَلَیْهِ مِنْ مَنْعِ رَسُول اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ الْقِیَامِ دُونَهُ إِلَّا أَبَالَهَبٍ کَمَا قَالَ اللَّهُ وَ لَیَنْصُرَنَّ اللهُ مَنْ یَنْصُرُهُ وَ قَدِمَ قَوْمٌ مِنْ قُرَیْشٍ مِنَ الطَّائِفِ وَ أَنْکَرُوا ذَلِکَ وَ وَقَعَتْ فِتْنَةٌ فَأَمَرَ النَّبِیُّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) الْمُسْلِمِینَ أَنْ یَخْرُجُوا إِلَی أَرْضِ الْحَبَشَة.
40.fa: امام سجّاد (- قریش نزد ابوطالب (گردهم آمدند ... مُطعمبنعدی گفت: «ای ابوطالب! سوگند به خداوند، قوم و قبیله‌ات [با ارائه‌کردن این پیشنهاد که محمّد (دست از دعوت خویش بردارد و آن‌ها نیز در مقابل، دست از مخالفت با او بردارند] با تو به انصاف و عدالت رفتار نموده و تلاش کردند که از آنچه تو نمی‌پسندی، رهایی یابند؛ ولی من چنین می‌بینم که تو نمی‌خواهی هیچ پیشنهادی را از آنان بپذیری»! ابوطالب (گفت: «به خدا سوگند آنان با من به انصاف و عدالت رفتار نکردند، بلکه هدف تو [از بیان این سخنان] آن است‌که مرا دچار درماندگی کرده و مردمان را بر ضدّ من بسیج نمایی؛ هرکاری می‌خواهی انجام ده». بعد از این جریان، هر قبیله بر مسلمانانی که در آن قبیله بودند، یورش بردند و به آزار و اذیّت آن‌ها پرداخته و تلاش کردند که آن‌ها را از دینشان بازگرداند و پیامبر (را مسخره میکردند. خداوند پیامبرش (را به‌وسیله‌ی عمویش ابوطالب (از [آزار] آنان بازمی‌داشت و چون ابوطالب (آزار و اذیّت قریش را مشاهده کرد در میان بنی‌هاشم ایستاده و همه‌ی آن‌ها - جز ابولهب - را مانند خود به حفظ رسول‌خدا (و همراهی با حضرت، دعوت نمود؛ چنانکه خداوند فرموده: وَ لَیَنْصُرَنَّ اللهُ مَنْ یَنْصُرُهُ. و گروهی از قریش از سرزمین طائف آمده و با این‌کار مخالفت کردند و فتنه‌ای [در مکّه] به‌پا شد و در نهایت، پیامبر (به مسلمانان دستور داد که به سرزمین حبشه بروند».
40.en:
In the Book of Prophethood, it is narrated from Zayn al-Abidin (peace be upon him) that the Quraysh gathered before Abu Talib (may Allah have mercy on him)... Al-Mut'im ibn Adi said, "By Allah, O Abu Talib, your people have treated you with fairness and have striven to rid you of what you dislike, yet I do not see you wishing to accept anything from them." Abu Talib (may Allah have mercy on him) replied, "By Allah, they have not treated me with fairness; rather, you have conspired to abandon me and to support the people against me. So, do whatever you wish."

Thereupon, every tribe fell upon the Muslims within their ranks, torturing them, trying to turn them away from their religion, and mocking the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family). Allah protected His Messenger from them through his uncle, Abu Talib. When Abu Talib (may Allah have mercy on him) saw what the Quraysh were doing to the Banu Hashim, he stood and called upon them—except for Abu Lahab—to join him in protecting the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) and standing in his defense, just as Allah has said: "And Allah will surely support those who support Him." A group of Quraysh then arrived from Ta'if and disapproved of this, and a tribulation ensued. Consequently, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) commanded the Muslims to depart for the land of Abyssinia.
40.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 686

41.ar: عَنِ الْإِمَامِ مُوسَی بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) عَنْ آبَائِهِ فِی قَوْلِهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ الَّذِینَ إِنْ مَکَّنَّاهُمْ فِی الْأَرْضِ أَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ آتَوُا الزَّکاةَ وَ أَمَرُوا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ نَهَوْا عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ؛ قَالَ نَحْنُ هُمْ.
41.fa: امام کاظم (- امام کاظم (به‌نقل از پدران بزرگوارش (در مورد این سخن خداوند عزّوجلّ [که می‌فرماید:] الَّذینَ إِنْ مَکَّنَّاهُمْ فِی الْأَرْضِ أَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ آتَوُا الزَّکاةَ وَ أَمَرُوا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ نَهَوْا عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ؛ فرمود: «مقصود از آن‌ها، ما (اهل‌بیت () هستیم».
41.en: From Imam Musa ibn Ja’far (peace be upon him), from his forefathers, regarding the saying of the Almighty and Majestic: "Those who, if We give them power in the land, establish prayer, pay the zakat, enjoin what is good, and forbid what is evil" (22:41); he said: "We are they."
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 686
41.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 164; Ta’wil al-Ayat al-Zahirah, p. 337; al-Manaqib, Vol. 4, p. 421; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Burhan

41.ar: عَنِ الزّهراء (سلام الله علیها): هَذِهِ نَزَلَتْ فِینَا أَهْلَ الْبَیْت.
41.fa: پیامبر (- از حضرت زهرا روایت است کهیامبر (فرمود: آیه‌ی الَّذینَ إِنْ مَکَّنَّاهُمْ فِی الْأَرْضِ أَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ آتَوُا الزَّکاةَ...؛ در مورد ما (اهل‌بیت () نازل شده است.
41.en: From al-Zahra (peace be upon her): This was revealed concerning us, the Ahl al-Bayt.
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 686
41.refs: Ta’wil al-Ayat al-Zahira, p. 338 / Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 166 / Nur al-Thaqalayn / al-Burhan

41.ar: عَنْ عِیسَی بْنِ دَاوُدَ عَنِ الْإِمَامِ أَبِی الْحَسَنِ مُوسَی بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) قَال کُنْتُ عِنْدَ أَبِی یَوْماً فِی الْمَسْجِدِ إِذْ أَتَاهُ رَجُلٌ فَوَقَفَ أَمَامَهُ وَ قَالَ یَا ابْنَ رَسُول اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) أَعْیَتْ عَلَیَّ آیَةٌ فِی کِتَابِ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ سَأَلْتُ عَنْهَا جَ-ابِرَ بْنَ یَزِیدَ فَأَرْشَدَنِی إِلَیْکَ فَقَالَ وَ مَا هِیَ قَالَ قَوْلُهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ الَّذِینَ إِنْ مَکَّنَّاهُمْ فِی الْأَرْضِ الْآیَةَ فَقَالَ نَعَمْ فِینَا نَزَلَتْ وَ ذَلِکَ أَنَّ فُلَاناً وَ فُلَاناً وَ طَائِفَةً مَعَهُمْ وَ سَمَّاهُمْ اجْتَمَعُوا إِلَی النَّبِیِّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) فَقَالُوا یَا رَسُول اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) إِلَی مَنْ یَصِیرُ هَذَا الْأَمْرُ بَعْدَکَ فَوَ اللَّهِ لَئِنْ صَارَ إِلَی رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ بَیْتِکَ إِنَّا لَنَخَافُهُمْ عَلَی أَنْفُسِنَا وَ لَوْ صَارَ إِلَی غَیْرِهِمْ لَعَلَّ غَیْرَهُمْ أَقْرَبُ وَ أَرْحَمُ بِنَا مِنْهُمْ فَغَضِبَ رَسُول اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) مِنْ ذَلِکَ غَضَباً شَدِیداً ثُمَّ قَالَ أَمَا وَ اللَّهِ لَوْ آمَنْتُمْ بِاللَّهِ وَ رَسُولِهِ مَا أَبْغَضْتُمُوهُمْ لِأَنَّ بُغْضَهُمْ بُغْضِی وَ بُغْضِی هُوَ الْکُفْرُ بِاللَّهِ ثُمَّ نَعَیْتُمْ إِلَیَّ نَفْسِی فَوَ اللَّهِ لَئِنْ مَکَّنَهُمُ اللَّهُ فِی الْأَرْضِ لَیُقِیمُونَ الصَّلَاةَ لِوَقْتِهَا وَ لَیُؤْتُونَ الزَّکَاةَ لِمَحَلِّهَا وَ لَیَأْمُرُنَّ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ لَیَنْهُنَّ عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ إِنَّمَا یُرْغِمُ اللَّهُ أُنُوفَ رِجَالٍ یُبْغِضُونَنِی وَ یُبْغِضُونَ أَهْلَ بَیْتِی وَ ذُرِّیَّتِی فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَ جَلَّ الَّذِینَ إِنْ مَکَّنَّاهُمْ فِی الْأَرْضِ إِلَی قَوْلِهِ وَ للهِ عاقِبَةُ الْأُمُورِ فَلَمْ یَقْبَلِ الْقَوْمُ ذَلِکَ فَأَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ سُبْحَانَهُ وَ إِنْ یُکَذِّبُوکَ فَقَدْ کَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَ عادٌ وَ ثَمُودُ* وَ قَوْمُ إِبْراهِیمَ وَ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ* وَ أَصْحابُ مَدْیَنَ وَ کُذِّبَ مُوسی فَأَمْلَیْتُ لِلْکافِرِینَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ فَکَیْفَ کانَ نَکِیرِ.
41.fa: امام کاظم (- عیسی‌بن‌داود از امام کاظم (نقل کرده که حضرت فرمود: «روزی در مسجد نزد پدرم (امام صادق () بودم که مردی نزد او آمد و در مقابل ایشان ایستاد و عرض‌کرد: «ای فرزند رسول‌خدا (! آیه‌ای در قرآن مرا درمانده کرده است، تفسیر آن را از جابربنیزید پرسیدم، او مرا به محضر شما راهنمایی کرد». پدرم فرمود: «آن آیه کدام است»؟ آن مرد گفت: «آیه‌ی الَّذینَ إِنْ مَکَّنَّاهُمْ فِی الْأَرْضِ...». پدرم فرمود: «آری! این آیه درباره‌ی ما (اهل‌بیت () نازل شده است و جریانش چنین است: فلانی و فلانی و گروهی که با آن‌دو بودند - که پدرم نام آن‌ها را ذکر کرد - خدمت پیامبر (آمده و پرسیدند: «خلافت بعد از شما به چه کسی خواهد رسید؟ به خدا سوگند! اگر به یکی از خویشاوندان شما برسد ما از خویشان تو بر جان خویش بیمناکیم؛ و اگر به کسی غیر از آن‌ها برسد، چه‌بسا کسی غیر از آن‌ها نسبت به ما نزدیک‌تر و مهربان‌تر باشد»! رسول‌خدا (از شنیدن این سخن بسیار ناراحت شد و فرمود: «به خدا سوگند! اگر به خدا و فرستاده‌اش ایمان داشتید، هرگز آنان را دشمن نمی‌پنداشتید؛ زیرا که دشمنی با آن‌ها دشمنی با من و دشمنی با من، کفر ورزیدن به خداوند است. شما [با این سخنتان] از مرگم به من خبر دادید! به خدا سوگند! اگر خداوند به آن‌ها در زمین قدرت دهد، نماز را در وقتش بهپای خواهند داشت و زکات را در جای خودش به مصرف رسانده و امر به معروف و نهی از منکر خواهند نمود؛ خداوند کسانی‌که با من و اهل‌بیتم دشمنی نمایند را خوار و ذلیل خواهد کرد». در این هنگام خداوند عزّوجلّ این آیه را نازل فرمود: الَّذینَ إِنْ مَکَّنَّاهُمْ فِی الْأَرْضِ أَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ آتَوُا الزَّکاةَ وَ أَمَرُوا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ نَهَوْا عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ وَ لِلهِ عاقِبَةُ الْأُمُورِ؛ با این‌حال، آن‌گروه فرمایش پیامبر (را نپذیرفتند؛ خداوند سبحان نیز این آیات را نازل فرمود: وَ إِنْ یُکَذِّبُوکَ فَقَدْ کَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَ عادٌ وَ ثَمُودُ * وَ قَوْمُ إِبْراهِیمَ وَ قَوْمُ لُوطٍ * وَ أَصْحابُ مَدْیَنَ وَ کُذِّبَ مُوسی فَأَمْلَیْتُ لِلْکافِرِینَ ثُمَّ أَخَذْتُهُمْ فَکَیْفَ کانَ نَکِیرِ.
41.en: Isa ibn Dawud narrated from Imam Abu al-Hasan Musa ibn Ja’far (peace be upon him) who said: I was with my father one day in the mosque when a man came to him, stood before him, and said, "O son of the Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family), a verse in the Book of Allah the Almighty has perplexed me. I asked Jabir ibn Yazid about it, and he directed me to you." He asked, "And what is it?" The man replied, "His saying, the Almighty, 'Those who, if We establish them in the land...'" He said, "Yes, it was revealed concerning us. The story is that so-and-so and so-and-so and a group with them—and he named them—gathered before the Prophet (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) and said, 'O Messenger of Allah, to whom will this affair pass after you? By Allah, if it passes to a man from your household, we fear for our own lives because of them; and if it passes to others, perhaps others are closer and more merciful to us than they are.' The Messenger of Allah (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) became intensely angry at this and said, 'By Allah, if you had believed in Allah and His Messenger, you would not have hated them, for hating them is hating me, and hating me is disbelief in Allah. You have [by this speech] announced my death to me! By Allah, if Allah establishes them in the land, they will surely establish prayer at its time, give zakat to its proper place, enjoin the good, and forbid the evil. Allah will surely humiliate those who hate me, my household, and my descendants.' Then Allah the Almighty revealed, 'Those who, if We establish them in the land...' up to His saying, 'And to Allah belongs the outcome of all matters.' The people did not accept this, so Allah the Glorified revealed, 'And if they deny you, then already before them did the people of Noah, and ‘Ad and Thamud deny [their messengers], and the people of Abraham and the people of Lot, and the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged [the time for] the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach!'"
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 686
41.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 165; Ta’wil al-Ayat al-Zahirah, p. 338; Al-Burhan

41.ar: عَنْ أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) فِی قَوْلِهِ الَّذِینَ إِنْ مَکَّنَّاهُمْ فِی الْأَرْضِ أَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ آتَوُا الزَّکاةَ؛ فَهَذِهِ لآِلِ مُحَمَّدِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) إِلَی آخِرِ الْأَئِمَّةِ (وَ الْمَهْدِیِّ (عجل الله تعالی فرجه الشریف) وَ أَصْحَابِهِ یَمْلِکُهُمُ اللَّهُ مَشَارِقَ الْأَرْضِ وَ مَغَارِبَهَا وَ یُظْهِرُ بِهِ الدِّینَ وَ یُمِیتُ اللَّهُ بِهِ وَ بِأَصْحَابِهِ الْبِدَعَ وَ الْبَاطِلَ کَمَا أَمَاتَ السُّفَهَاءُ الْحَقَّ حَتَّی لَا یُرَی أَیْنَ الظُّلْمُ وَ یَأْمُرُونَ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ یَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ.
41.fa: امام باقر (- از امامباقر (نقل‌شده که در مورد آیه‌ی: الَّذینَ إِنْ مَکَّنَّاهُمْ فِی الْأَرْضِ أَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ آتَوُا الزَّکاةَ؛ فرمود: «این آیه اختصاص به آل‌محمّد (تا آخرین امام، و حضرت‌مهدی (و یارانش دارد، همان کسانی‌که خداوند آن‌ها را مالک شرق و غرب زمین خواهد نمود و دین را به‌وسیله‌ی او آشکار کند و بدعت‌ها و ناحقّ را به‌وسیله‌ی او و یارانش از میان بردارد؛ آنچنان‌که بی‌خِردان، حقّ را نابود کرده‌اند؛ و [عدالت آنگونه گسترش یابد که] اثری از ظلم باقی نمی‌ماند؛ و آن‌ها امر به معروف و نهی از منکر میکنند».
41.en: From Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him) regarding the words of Allah, "Those who, if We give them power in the land, establish prayer and give zakat": This refers to the Family of Muhammad (blessings of Allah be upon him and his family) until the last of the Imams. The Mahdi (may Allah hasten his noble reappearance) and his companions will be granted by Allah dominion over the east and west of the earth. Through him, Allah will manifest the religion, and through him and his companions, Allah will cause innovations and falsehood to die, just as the foolish ones caused the truth to die, until no trace of injustice is seen. They will enjoin the good and forbid the evil.
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 688
41.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 51, p. 47; al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 87; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 165; Ta’wil al-Ayat al-Zahira, p. 339; Nur al-Thaqalayn; "al-Shaqqa" instead of "al-Sufaha"; al-Burhan.

41.ar: عَنْ أَبِی خَلِیفَةَ قَالَ: دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَ أَبُوعُبَیْدَةَ الْحَذَّاءُ عَلَی أَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) ... قُلْتُ لِأَبِی جَعْفَرٍ (علیه السلام) کَیْفَ لَنَا بِصَاحِبِ هَذَا الْأَمْرِ حَتَّی نَعْرِفَ قَالَ فَقَالَ قَوْلُ اللَّهِ تَعَالَی الَّذِینَ إِنْ مَکَّنَّاهُمْ فِی الْأَرْضِ أَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ آتَوُا الزَّکاةَ وَ أَمَرُوا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ نَهَوْا عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ إِذْ رَأَیْتَ هَذَا الرَّجُلَ مِنَّا فَاتَّبِعْهُ فَإِنَّهُ هُوَ صَاحِبُکَ.
41.fa: امام باقر (- ابوخلیفه گوید: من و ابوعُبیده‌ی حَذّاء خدمت امام باقر (رسیدیم... من به امام (عرضکردم: «ما چگونه میتوانیم امام معصوم را بشناسیم»؟ حضرت فرمود: «از این سخن خداوند تعالی [که فرموده]: الَّذِینَ إِنْ مَکَّنَّاهُمْ فِی الْأَرْضِ أَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ آتَوُا الزَّکاةَ وَ أَمَرُوا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ نَهَوْا عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ؛ هرگاه چنین کسی را از ما اهل‌بیت دیدی، از او پیروی کن که او امام توست».
41.en: Abu Khalifah said: I and Abu Ubaydah al-Hadhdha entered upon Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him)... I said to Abu Ja’far (peace be upon him), "How can we recognize the Master of this Affair (Sahib al-Amr)?" He replied, "It is the saying of Allah the Exalted: 'Those who, if We give them power in the land, establish prayer, pay the zakat, enjoin what is right, and forbid what is wrong.' When you see this man from among us, follow him, for he is your Master."
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 688
41.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 25, p. 164; Furat al-Kufi, p. 274; Shawahid al-Tanzil, Vol. 1, p. 522; "Sahibuhu" (his master) is an alternative reading for "Sahibuka" (your master).

41.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ تَبَارَکَ اسْمُهُ وَضَعَ إِمَامَتِی فِی قُرْآنِهِ فَقَالَ وَ الَّذِینَ یَبِیتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمْ سُجَّداً وَ قِیاماً وَ الَّذِینَ یَقُولُونَ رَبَّنا هَبْ لَنا مِنْ أَزْواجِنا وَ ذُرِّیَّاتِنا قُرَّةَ أَعْیُنٍ وَ اجْعَلْنا لِلْمُتَّقِینَ إِماماً، وَ قَالَ الَّذِینَ إِنْ مَکَّنَّاهُمْ فِی الْأَرْضِ أَقامُوا الصَّلاةَ وَ آتَوُا الزَّکاةَ وَ أَمَرُوا بِالْمَعْرُوفِ وَ نَهَوْا عَنِ الْمُنْکَرِ وَ للهِ عاقِبَةُ الْأُمُورِ.
41.en: Indeed, Allah—blessed be His name—has placed my Imamate in His Quran, for He says: "And those who spend the night prostrating and standing before their Lord," and "And those who say, 'Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us an example for the righteous,'" and He says: "Those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer, give zakat, enjoin what is right, and forbid what is wrong; and to Allah belongs the outcome of all matters."
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 688
41.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 29, p. 565; al-Adad al-Qawiyyah, p. 199

41.ar: رَوَی الشَّیْخُ الْمُفِیدُ (رحمة الله علیه) بِإِسْنَادِهِ إِلَی مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ السَّائِبِ الْکَلْبِیِّ قَال لَمَّا قَدِمَ الصَّادِقُ (علیه السلام) الْعِرَاقَ نَزَلَ الْحِیرَةَ فَدَخَلَ عَلَیْهِ أَبُوحَنِیفَةَ وَ سَأَلَهُ عَنْ مَسَائِلَ وَ کَانَ مِمَّا سَأَلَهُ أَنْ قَالَ لَهُ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاکَ مَا الْأَمْرُ بِالْمَعْرُوفِ فَقَالَ (علیه السلام) الْمَعْرُوفُ یَا أَبَاحَنِیفَةَ الْمَعْرُوفُ فِی أَهْلِ السَّمَاءِ الْمَعْرُوفُ فِی أَهْلِ الْأَرْضِ وَ ذَلِکَ أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ عَلِیُّ بْنُ أَبِی طَالِبٍ (علیه السلام) قَالَ جُعِلْتُ فِدَاکَ فَمَا الْمُنْکَرُ قَالَ اللَّذَانِ ظَلَمَاهُ حَقَّهُ وَ ابْتَزَّاهُ أَمْرَهُ وَ حَمَلَا النَّاسَ عَلَی کَتِفِهِ قَالَ أَلَا مَا هُوَ أَنْ تَرَی الرَّجُلَ عَلَی مَعَاصِی اللَّهِ فَتَنْهَاهُ عَنْهَا فَقَالَ أَبُوعَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) لَیْسَ ذَاکَ أَمْرٌ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَ لَا نَهْیٌ عَنْ مُنْکَرٍ إِنَّمَا ذَلِکَ خَیْرٌ قَدَّمَهُ.
41.fa: امام صادق (- شیخ مفید (با سندش از محمّدبن‌سائب‌کلبی چنین روایت کرده است: وقتی امام صادق (به عراق آمد ساکن حیره شد. ابوحنیفه خدمت امام (رسید و مسائلی را از ایشان پرسید. از جمله سؤالهایش این بود که گفت: «فدایت شوم! امر به معروف چیست»؟ حضرت فرمود: «ای اباحنیفه! معروف آن است که در میان اهل آسمان و اهل زمین، شناخته شده باشد که همان امیرالمؤمنین علیّبنابی‌طالب (است».
41.en: Shaykh al-Mufid (may Allah have mercy upon him) narrated with his chain of transmission to Muhammad ibn al-Sa’ib al-Kalbi, who said: When al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) came to Iraq, he stayed in al-Hirah. Abu Hanifah came to him and asked him about some issues. Among the things he asked him was: "May I be made your ransom, what is 'enjoining the good' (al-amr bi-al-ma'ruf)?" He (peace be upon him) said: "The 'good' (al-ma'ruf), O Abu Hanifah, is that which is known among the people of the heavens and known among the people of the earth, and that is the Commander of the Faithful, Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him)." He said: "May I be made your ransom, then what is the 'evil' (al-munkar)?" He said: "The two who wronged him of his right, usurped his authority, and forced the people upon his shoulders." He [Abu Hanifah] said: "Is it not that you see a man committing acts of disobedience to Allah and you forbid him from them?" Abu ‘Abd Allah (peace be upon him) said: "That is neither enjoining the good nor forbidding the evil; that is merely a good deed he has put forward."
41.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 690

45.ar: الْبِئْرُ الْمُعَطَّلَةُ الْإِمَامُ الصَّامِتُ وَ الْقَصْرُ الْمَشِیدُ؛ الْإِمَامُ النَّاطِقُ.
45.fa: امام کاظم (- علی‌بن‌جعفر از برادر بزرگوارش امام‌کاظم (نقل کرده که درباره‌ی این سخن خداوند [که می‌فرماید]: وَ بِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ وَ قَصْرٍ مَشیدٍ؛ فرمود: «چاه پرآبِ متروک، امام خاموش [به‌خاطر شرایط تقیّه] و قصر محکم و برافراشته، امام گویا است».
45.en: The "abandoned well" is the silent Imam, and the "lofty palace" is the speaking Imam.
45.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 690
45.refs: al-Kafi, Vol. 1, p. 427; Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahirah, p. 339; Masa'il Ali ibn Ja'far, p. 317; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Burhan; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 101; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 25, p. 107; Kamal al-Din, p. 417, no. 2; Basa'ir al-Darajat, p. 505; Ma'ani al-Akhbar, p. 111

45.ar: وَ بِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ وَ قَصْرٍ مَشِیدٍ؛ قَالَ هُوَ مَثَلٌ لِآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) قَوْلُهُ بِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ؛ هُوَ الَّذِی لَا یُسْتَقَی مِنْهَا وَ هُوَ الْإِمَامُ الَّذِی قَدْ غَابَ فَلَا یُقْتَبَسُ مِنْهُ الْعِلْمُ إِلَی وَقْتِ الظُّهُورِ وَ الْقَ-صْرُ الْمَشِیدُ هُوَ الْمُرْتَفِعُ وَ هُوَ مَثَلٌ لِأَمِیرِ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ (علیه السلام) وَ الْأَئِمَّةِ (وَ فَضَائِلِهِمُ الْمُنْتَشِرَةِ فِی الْعَالَمِینَ الْمُشْرِفَةِ عَلَی الدُّنْیَا وَ هُوَ قَوْلُهُ لِیُظْهِرَهُ عَلَی الدِّینِ کُلِّه.
45.en: "And a neglected well and a lofty palace." He said: This is a parable for the Family of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family). As for His saying, "a neglected well," it is that from which no water is drawn; it is the Imam who has gone into occultation, such that knowledge is not sought from him until the time of his reappearance. And the "lofty palace" is that which is elevated; it is a parable for the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) and the Imams (peace be upon them), and their virtues which are spread throughout the worlds, overlooking the world. This is [the meaning of] His saying: "That He may make it prevail over all religions." (Tawbah/ 33)
45.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 690
45.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 101; al-Qummi, Vol. 2, p. 85; "spread throughout the worlds" is omitted [in some versions]; Nur al-Thaqalayn

45.ar: عَن جَعفَر الصَّادق (علیه السلام)، فی قوله تعالی: وَ بِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ وَ قَصْرٍ مَشِیدٍ أنَّه قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُول اللَّهِ (صلی الله علیه و آله) الْقَصْرُ الْمَشِیدُ وَ الْبِئْرُ الْمُعَطَّلَةُ عَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام).
45.fa: امام صادق (- در تفسیر آیه‌ی وَ بِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ وَ قَصْرٍ مَشِیدٍ؛ امام صادق (فرمود: رسول‌خدا (فرموده: «من «قصر مشید» هستم و علی («بئر معطّله» است».
45.en: From Ja’far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), regarding the words of the Exalted: "And a neglected well and a lofty palace," he said: The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: "The lofty palace and the neglected well are Ali (peace be upon him)."
45.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 692
45.refs: Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 24, p. 103; Bihar al-Anwar, Vol. 36, p. 104; Ta’wil al-Ayat al-Zahirah, p. 340; Furat al-Kufi, p. 274; al-Manaqib, Vol. 3, p. 88; al-Burhan

45.ar: عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ سَهْلٍ قَالَ سَمِعْتُ أَبَاعَبْدِ اللَّهِ (علیه السلام) یَقُولُ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَی وَ بِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ وَ قَصْرٍ مَشِید أَمِیرُ الْمُؤْمِنِینَ الْقَصْرُ الْمَشِیدُ وَ الْبِئْرُ الْمُعَطَّلَةُ فَاطِمَةُ (سلام الله علیها) وَ وَلَدَیْهَا مُعَطَّلُونَ مِنَ الْمُلْکِ.
45.fa: امام صادق (- صالح‌بن‌سعد گوید: از امام‌صادق (شنیدم که درباره‌ی آیه‌ی وَ بِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ وَ قَصْرٍ مَشیدٍ؛ می‌فرمود: «منظور از «قصر مشید» امیرالمؤمنین (و منظور از «بئر معطّله» فاطمه (و دو فرزند او هستند که از زمامداری [بر مسلمانان] بازداشته شده‌اند».
45.en: Salih ibn Sahl said: I heard Abu Abd Allah (peace be upon him) say regarding the words of the Exalted, "And a neglected well and a lofty palace": The "lofty palace" is the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), and the "neglected well" is Fatima (peace be upon her) and her two sons, who were neglected [deprived] of the kingdom.
45.book: Tafsir Ahl al-Bayt (peace be upon them), Vol. 9, p. 692
45.refs: Ta'wil al-Ayat al-Zahira, p. 339; Nur al-Thaqalayn; al-Burhan

45.ar: الأئمّة (- وَ کَمْ مِنْ عَالِمٍ لَا یَرْجِعُ الیه وَ لَا یُنْتَفَعُ بِعِلْمِهِ.
45.fa: ائمه (- در تفسیر اهل‌بیت (نسبت به این سخن خداوند: وَ بِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ؛ آمده: «یعنی چه بسیار عالمی که [برای دریافت علم] به او مراجعه نمیگردد و از علمش، بهره‌برداری نمی‌شود».
45.en: "And how many a scholar there is to whom one does not turn, and from whose knowledge no benefit is derived."

45.ar: فَالْقَصْرُ؛ مُحَمَّدٌ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ الْبِئْرُ الْمُعَطَّلَةُ؛ وَلَایَتِی عَطَّلُوهَا وَ جَحَدُوهَا وَ مَنْ لَمْ یُقِرَّ بِوَلَایَتِی لَمْ یَنْفَعْهُ الْإِقْرَارُ بِنُبُوَّةِ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) إِلَّا أَنَّهُمَا مَقْرُونَانِ وَ ذَلِکَ أَنَّ النَّبِیَّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) نَبِیٌّ مُرْسَلٌ وَ هُوَ إِمَامُ الْخَلْقِ وَ عَلِیٌّ (علیه السلام) مِنْ بَعْدِهِ إِمَامُ الْخَلْقِ وَ وَصِیُّ مُحَمَّدٍ (صلی الله علیه و آله) کَمَا قَالَ لَهُ النَّبِیُّ (صلی الله علیه و آله) أَنْتَ مِنِّی بِمَنْزِلَةِ هَارُونَ (علیه السلام) مِنْ مُوسَی (علیه السلام) إِلَّا أَنَّهُ لَا نَبِیَّ بَعْدِی وَ أَوَّلُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ (صلی الله علیه و آله) وَ أَوْسَطُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ (علیه السلام) وَ آخِرُنَا مُحَمَّدٌ (علیه السلام) فَمَنِ اسْتَکْمَلَ مَعْرِفَتِی فَهُوَ عَلَی الدِّینِ الْقَیِّم.
45.fa: امام علی (- ...خداوند تعالی در جایی دیگر از کتابش درباره‌ی نبوّت حضرت محمد (و ولایت من فرموده: وَ بِئْرٍ مُعَطَّلَةٍ وَ قَصْرٍ مَشِیدٍ؛ منظور از «قصر» حضرت محمد (و منظور از «بئر معطّله» ولایت‌من است که دیگران، آن را رها کرده و انکارش نمودند؛ هرکس به ولایت من اعتراف نداشته‌باشد اعتراف به نبوّت حضرت محمد (سودی برایش نخواهد داشت، این‌دو با هم قرین و همراهند؛ زیرا رسول‌خدا (پیامبری فرستاده شده و پیشوای مردم است و پس از او، علی (پیشوای مردم و جانشین حضرت محمد (است؛ چنانکه پیامبر (به او فرمود: «تو نسبت به من، همچون هارون (نسبت به موسی (هستی، جز اینکه بعد از من پیامبری نخواهد بود». [نامِ] اوّلین نفر از ما (چهارده‌معصوم) محمد (، [نامِ] نفر میانه‌ی ما محمد (امام‌باقر () و [نامِ] آخرین فرد از ما نیز محمّد (حضرت مهدی () است؛ هرکس به‌طور کامل، مرا بشناسد او بر دین پایدار و استوار است.
45.en: The "palace" (qasr) is Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family), and the "abandoned well" (bi'r mu'attala) is my wilaya (guardianship), which they abandoned and denied. Whoever does not acknowledge my wilaya, the acknowledgment of the prophethood of Muhammad (peace be upon him and his family) will not benefit him.
